_comment: User-editable overrides for picks.json. Three operations: 'add' (insert new picks for traded ones the auto-generator missed), 'remove' (delete picks a team no longer owns), 'edit' (change fields on existing picks by id, e.g. add protections). Re-run scripts/generate_picks.py after editing.
_swap_fields: For pick swaps, set swap_type to 'best_of' (gets the lower pick #) or 'worst_of' (gets the higher pick #), and swap_partners to the other team abbreviations. expected_pick must be hand-authored to reflect the projected swap outcome. Example HOU/PHX 2027 swap below.
